Ram Mandir donation row sparks political accusations and internal trust changes

Allegations of donation irregularities have emerged concerning the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya and a temple in Madhya Pradesh. In response, the Congress party has demanded the dissolution of the Ram Mandir Trust and the arrest of its manager, linking the issue to other donation controversies. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has stated that action has been taken against those found guilty and criticized the opposition for politicizing the matter, while a manager of the Ram Mandir Trust has reportedly stepped away from the temple premises.
